executivePulse.interpretation: The situation for memory and AI infrastructure remains strained. Server DRAM / RDIMM, HBM and enterprise SSDs are currently among the most constrained segments. The Daily Check of 2026-08-30 reviewed 8 current relevant reports; it shows no confirmed material change in direction. New capacity and improved yields can provide relief but will reach the market only with a time lag. For buyers, supply assurance, alternative BOMs and early procurement remain decisive.
